## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] User-facing strings are added to `src/i18n.ts` and, if needed, `package.nls*.json`.
- [ ] New behavior has tests.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for user-visible changes.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or private registry URLs are included.
- [ ] Webview changes escape untrusted values.
- [ ] Installer/publisher changes preserve path-traversal and overwrite protections.
